title: Annadaan Project
summary: As an ongoing monthly initiative, the Club distributes nutritious food to street children and needy workers for around 10–12 days every month.
description: As an ongoing monthly initiative, the Club distributes nutritious food to street children and needy workers for around 10–12 days every month. The project aims to provide regular nourishment and support to those in need. This sustained effort reflects the Club’s commitment to hunger relief and community welfare.
